description: This file is a Java implementation of the ShoppingCartDao, providing database access methods for ShoppingCart entities, including retrieval by ID, code, customer, and deletion, using JPA queries and repositories.

classes.name: ShoppingCartDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ShoppingCartDao providing database operations for ShoppingCart entities within a Spring repository, including various fetch methods for shopping cart data.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart entity by its ID.
